quirks_ledger.title: vllm_image add_local_dir() layer-order violation
quirks_ledger.impact: Modal image builds fail when run_commands/pip_install steps appear after add_local_dir() in the chain.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Move add_local_dir() to the final step of vllm_image in scripts/modal_train.py.

quirks_ledger.title: L4 22 GiB OOM during SFT forward pass & TRL 0.16 KV-cache rollout stall
quirks_ledger.impact: Initial L4 smoke test hit torch.OutOfMemoryError (44 MiB over 22.08 GiB) at batch_size=4; enabling gradient checkpointing then disabled KV caching during TRL 0.16 GRPO rollouts (QUIRK-006 in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md).
quirks_ledger.resolution: Enabled gradient_checkpointing=True (use_reentrant=False), PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, and _KVCacheGRPOTrainer eval/use_cache toggle during rollouts (0 OOMs; SFT 23.4s, GRPO 283.7s).

quirks_ledger.title: Qwen3 enable_thinking=False default causes doubled <think> tokens
quirks_ledger.impact: Mismatched chat template defaults between SFT, GRPO, and eval produce broken reasoning prefixes.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Pass explicit enable_thinking flag consistently across SFT, GRPO, and evaluate.py with matching require_think_close.

quirks_ledger.title: Stockfish 16 SIGFPE (exit -8) crash under repeated search reuse
quirks_ledger.impact: Long-running evaluation and pytest suites intermittently crash when reusing a single Stockfish process.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Wrapped open_engine() and ChessEnv in ResilientEngine auto-restart with preserved UCI options across engine.py, chess_env.py, and all live Stockfish tests.

quirks_ledger.title: evaluate.py unpaired opening indexing breaks color-balanced pairing
quirks_ledger.impact: Using g % len(opening_fens) gives White and Black different openings instead of paired color swaps.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Index openings with (g // 2) % len(opening_fens), honor model_color as Game 1 color, and report White/Black splits separately.

quirks_ledger.title: jsDelivr returns HTTP 403 on stockfish@19.0.1 package paths
quirks_ledger.impact: Remote CDN loading of Stockfish 19 WASM fails in browsers with 403 Forbidden.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Vendor and pin single-threaded stockfish-19-lite-single.{js,wasm} locally in web/vendor/stockfish/ with GPL-3.0 attribution.

quirks_ledger.title: Maia-3 weights are AGPL-licensed
quirks_ledger.impact: Bundling or referencing AGPL weights conflicts with clean MIT open-source distribution of the static coach.
quirks_ledger.resolution: Pin MIT-licensed Maia-2 commit (maia_rapid.onnx) with explicit MAIA2_LICENSE.txt attribution.

quirks_ledger.title: Root .gitignore data/ rule ignored web/data/*.json
quirks_ledger.impact: Dashboard and opening JSON files under web/data/ were silently excluded from git status and commits.
